statement.notes: 1. 'total_revenue' is mapped from 'Sales revenue'. 2. 'total_operating_cost' is constructed from the sum of Cost of sales, Distribution expenses, Administrative expenses, and Other operating expenses, minus Other operating income (as it is a positive component that reduces total operating cost). All values are treated as positive numbers as they are expenses that reduce income. 3. 'net_income' is mapped from 'Earnings after tax'. 4. 'taxes' is mapped from 'Income tax income/expense'. The sign convention is followed: the tax expense reduces income, so it is reported as a positive number. 5. 'interest_expenses' is constructed from 'Interest expenses' (positive) and 'Interest income' (negative, as it increases income). This follows the sign convention where items that reduce income are positive. 6. The 'Share of the result of equity-accounted investments' and 'Other financial result' are not included in the requested fields as they are part of the financial result below operating income and are not part of total_operating_cost or interest_expenses as defined. 7. Scale is 1E6 (millions) as indicated by '€ million'.
